intents.intent: AIG targets an IPO of CoreBridge Financial (life and retirement business) in the second quarter, subject to market conditions and required regulatory approvals, retaining greater than 50% interest post-IPO.
AIG will begin transferring assets to BlackRock over the course of Q2 2022 following signing of IMAs.
AIG will receive the remaining $1.9 billion under the CoreBridge promissory note during Q2 2022.
